main_text.l: Omnino perfectionem amœnitatis huius in-
stituit Deus: amœnitate facit odoramentorum
communio, communionem charitas, quæ per-
fectionis vinculum à Paulo dicitur: pax necessa-
rium est charitatis instrumentum.
Quid ergo putamus, miseri? quid fingimus,
cùm tanto supercilio alij alios quasi furcilla ex-
trudimus, & censoriam quandam virgulam in
hos, in illos promiscuè adhibemus, tanquam si
nobis solùm esset iudicij nasus; aut Christus
hanc facultatem cessisset nobis, qua ad libidi-
nem animi nostri abutamur? Id sanè faciant
Satanæ stabularij: at oues Christi non decet,
pastores minimè. Quin potiùs Christo cedi-
mus, nos & illos in communionem corporis
& Spiritus sui gratiosissimè adhibenti? Quin
potiùs odores amœnissimos ab illo in nos der-
iuantem manu ipsius animaduertimus? quin
potiùs unguento illo odoratissimo fratres com-
muniter nobiscum sentimus delibutos? quin
potiùs etiam amicos ad participationem suauis-
simi eiusdem odoris ab illo capite in corpus
unum adscitum iri confidimus? quin potiùs
& continendis iis qui iam vocati sunt, & vo-
candis qui abfunt, damus operam diligentis-
simè; ab omni fœtore abstinentes, quo crepant
animi nostri, & omnem suauissimum odorem
illis exhibentes, qui ad Christum & ad nos per
Christum unà perducantur? O beatum stu-
dium eorum, qui in hoc pietatis officio con-
fumunt

page.notes: The printed page is a single text column with page number 200 and running head EIRENICI at the top. The word "confumunt" is broken at the line end as "con-" / "fumunt", and is written here with its printed hyphen. Long s has been transcribed as s throughout. Forms such as "fi" (si), "folùm" (solùm) and "effet" (esset) are read as shown on the scan, but the long-s letters are less clear at this resolution, so they are open to doubt. Small marks at the right edge of the scan are show-through or the book edge and are not transcribed.
